summary: Integrated Media Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification granting an additional 180 calendar days (until December 29, 2026) to regain compliance with the $1 minimum bid price requirement. The company had not regained compliance within the initial 180-day period that ended June 29, 2026. To regain compliance, the closing bid price must be at least $1 per share for ten consecutive business days during the extended period. The company intends to consider all available options. This is a routine listing compliance update, not a special situation.
